caption: The drawing features a large, outlined pot or vessel at the upper center, rendered in simple, thin blue lines with two small handles on either side. The upper section of the pot includes a cluster of small, dark, circular and semi-circular shapes, connected by curved lines resembling scalloped patterns, which drip downward from the rim. Below the pot, occupying the majority of the lower half of the composition, is a large, irregular arrangement of overlapping, thick, dark blue crescent or scallop forms, each containing one solid dot, placed against a loosely shaded brownish-gray rectangular background. The background gradient starts darker in the lower section and gradually fades to a lighter shade towards the upper section, where the pot is positioned. The entire image is bordered by a plain beige or off-white paper. There is a faint cursive signature in the bottom left corner.
title: Crock
